fusions.name: Behind the Knee
fusions.desc: A low cut that deals 12 damage, leaves the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 6 seconds and [Slowed] for 6 seconds. Your afflictions on it spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Tucked Blades
fusions.desc: Flicks a hidden blade at an enemy within 6 tiles that deals 6 damage and leaves it [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 10 seconds. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Whetted in Idle Hours
fusions.desc: Your critical hits deal 30% more damage for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Retracted Claws
fusions.desc: Conjures a set of long claws. They increase your weapon damage by 12% and your maximum health by 10, and every strike with them leaves the target [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds.
